lead: Joy Mukherjee was a film director, born on 24 February 1939 in Jhansi.
He died on 9 March 2012 in Mumbai at the age of 73.
He has 23 credited works on public record.

sections.heading: Joy Mukherjee — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Joy Mukherjee was born on 24 February 1939 in Jhansi, and holds citizenship of British Raj, India and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Sashadhar Mukherjee and his mother, Sati Devi Mukherjee. He is a sibling of Shomu Mukherjee, Deb Mukherjee, Shubir Mukherjee and Rono Mukherjee.
